svg.font-family: system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: L — Sky islands · Thrills & Chills round-4 art concept
svg.text: The park floats on pastel islands tied together with rope
bridges, over a sea of cloud. Curvy, grown-not-built rides,
backlit: lilac shade and a thin white rim on every edge.

g.text: Light from behind: rim line on the sun side.
Shade = mix toward lilac #8a74c8, never grey.
Soft gradients: sides, balls, petals, the sky.
Islands: blob top + hanging rock, cloud sea.
Cars and cups are tubs: riders sit inside.
